costPriceAssumptions.containerApps: Consumption: vCPU 0.000034/s, memory 0.000004/GiB-s, requests 0.40/1M, environment 0.10/hour (fixed cost excluded from incremental projection)
costPriceAssumptions.pages: pages_estimated = ceil(rows / 10000); ensure responses do not expose provider pagination, so this is an estimate

limitations: The deployed ingest is bounded at LAKE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS=1000 records per data type, so recorded rows and bytes are lower bounds on full SIP depth; T050 should pair recorded bytes with the config's assumed_bytes_per_session planning values until an unbounded ingest path exists (lake finding).
Dev API ingress is internal-only and the app scales to zero, so workstation runs require the temporary posture flip documented in the runbook; in-cluster runners avoid it.
The local lake composition cannot host the full soak: lake local ingest is bounded at 10000 records per invocation, marks every session partial, and handles one session per call (lake finding).
Pages are estimated from row counts, not observed provider pagination; a future lake capability could expose real page counts for exact request-cost math.
